input.text:
Lady Gaga and Bruno Mars' "Die With A Smile" is two years old and still a Spotify global top 10 song: No. 10 on the chart week of Oct 15, 2026, up from No. 15, with 19.1M streams (+1.8M).

Released Aug 16, 2024 on Interscope (written by Gaga, Bruno Mars, D'Mile, James Fauntleroy and Andrew Watt), it has been on Spotify's global weekly chart for all 113 weeks since, 62 of them in the top 10. It spent 30 weeks at No. 1, the most of any song in kworb's Spotify global weekly history (since Sep 29, 2013); the next best are Dance Monkey and rockstar with 17. It has 4.0B streams on that chart.

Its weekly streams peaked at 78.6M (Sep 26, 2024), bottomed near 16.3M (Jul 9, 2026) and have climbed back to 19.1M. For comparison, Billie Eilish's "BIRDS OF A FEATHER" has 71 top-10 weeks in 126, while The Weeknd's "Blinding Lights" has 64 in 359.

The run started with a No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 (chart dated Jan 11, 2025) and the Best Pop Duo/Group Performance Grammy in Feb 2025; Billboard's Global 200 had it at No. 1 for 18 weeks.

Will it still be top 10 on its third birthday, Aug 16, 2027? Save this and tell us your guess. 👇

Data: kworb Spotify global weekly chart (through Oct 15, 2026), Spotify monthly listeners, Wikipedia
